item.title: Anime Festival Asia Hong Kong 2026 has been postponed
item.description: Anime Festival Asia Hong Kong 2026 has been postponed, the organisers have confirmed. In an announcement shared online, the team revealed that Anime Festival Asia Hong Kong 2026, which was originally scheduled to take place on 14 – 15 February at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, will no longer go ahead on its planned dates. “We sincerely apologise for any inconvenience caused and greatly appreciate your understanding and support,” the organisers stated.
